bay:metadata.bay:title: B2B Autopilot / Builders Net Sovereign Federation Platform
bay:metadata.bay:summary: Authoritative system architecture specification governing the 9 sovereign repositories, SPIFFE/mTLS airlocks, WireGuard userspace transport, payload-blind relay forwarders, sandboxed MCP agent runtimes, and Order-to-Cash service contracts.
bay:metadata.bay:authority: This XML document is the primary architecture authority for all b2bautopilot/xx-* repositories. All runtime changes, schema changes, and contract evolutions must be recorded and sealed in this document.
